# dart-compile.yml

<link-summary>Inputs, secrets and outputs of the reusable workflow Dart compile.</link-summary>

```text
Compiles the executables of Dart packages to native binaries for every target, each on a runner
of its own operating system and architecture, smoke tests them and packages them as
<name>-<target>.zip (or .tar.gz) with a .sha256 file. Every archive is an artifact
release-assets-<name>-<target> that github-release.yml attaches to the release.
```

```yaml
jobs:
  dart-compile:
    uses: davils-com/workflows/.github/workflows/dart-compile.yml@v1
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `working-directory` | string | `.` | Directory of the root pubspec.yaml, relative to the repository root. |
| `discovery` | string | empty | Packages discovered before (pipeline.yml passes its own); empty discovers them here. |
| `include` | string | empty | Globs of package directories outside the workspace. |
| `exclude` | string | empty | Globs of package directories to leave out. |
| `executables` | string | empty | JSON array of {package, entrypoint, name}; empty compiles every executable of the pubspec.yaml files. |
| `targets` | string | `["linux-x64","linux-arm64","macos-arm64","macos-x64","windows-x64"]` | JSON array of targets (linux-x64, linux-arm64, macos-arm64, macos-x64, windows-x64, windows-arm64). |
| `sdk` | string | `stable` | Dart SDK (stable, beta or a version). |
| `compile-command` | string | empty | Replaces dart compile exe; runs in the package directory with ENTRYPOINT and OUTPUT set. |
| `compile-args` | string | empty | Extra arguments for dart compile exe, such as --define=VERSION=1.0.0. |
| `archive` | string | `zip` | zip or tar.gz. |
| `smoke-test-args` | string | `--version` | Arguments the compiled binary is run with as a smoke test; empty skips it. |
| `artifact-prefix` | string | `release-assets` | Prefix of the artifact names. |
| `runners` | string | `{}` | JSON object of runner labels (linux, linux-arm, macos, macos-intel, windows, windows-arm). |
| `timeout-minutes` | number | `30` | Timeout of every compile job. |
| `fail-fast` | boolean | `false` | Cancel the other targets when one fails. |
| `harden-runner` | boolean | `true` | Run step-security/harden-runner first on Linux runners. |
| `harden-runner-egress-policy` | string | `audit` | audit or block. |
| `harden-runner-allowed-endpoints` | string | empty | Endpoints allowed with the block policy, space separated. |
| `pre-setup` | string | empty | Shell commands run before any tool is set up. |
| `post-setup` | string | empty | Shell commands run after the dependencies are resolved. |
| `artifact-retention-days` | number | `14` | Days to keep the binaries. |
| `pub-hosted-url` | string | empty | URL of a private package host; its token is the secret PUB_HOSTED_TOKEN. |
| `git-host` | string | `github.com` | Host of private git dependencies; its token is the secret GIT_DEPS_TOKEN. |

## Secrets

All secrets are optional.

- `PUB_HOSTED_TOKEN`
- `GIT_DEPS_TOKEN`

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `matrix` | The compiled executables and targets, as a JSON matrix. |

## Permissions the caller grants

- `contents: read`
